description: Buyer ORDER DRAFT (scope draft_order; OAuth grant). create: ONE quote_token → frozen snapshot (single-use), or items → one draft per checkout group (one fee/approval/payment). SNAPSHOT ONLY: no order/charge/stock; drift at approval hard-fails. 24h expiry. Zero PII. Next: webaz_submit_order_request; human approval creates the order.

draft_id.description: cancel/get: the odr_ or ogd_ id

idempotency_key.description: create with quote_token (optional): [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}; same key replays the draft

quote_token.description: create: the qtk_ token from webaz_quote_order (single-use)

name: webaz_order_draft

outputSchema.description: webaz.order_draft.model.v2 — consumer draft projection (single or {count,drafts[]}): frozen snapshot, nothing charged, no stock held, 24h expiry

error.description: present ONLY on failure (with error_code + structured recovery fields)

price.description: product price: amount_minor / currency USDC / display (display line only; fx table gives display-only local conversions)

quantity.description: positive integer, or null when invalid (see quantity_valid); display-only (amount=price.amount_minor)

quantity_valid.description: false only when quantity is invalid data (card shows 数量数据异常, buttons disabled)

status.description: v2 status {code,label,label_en}; code canonical (never from label)
